functions.name: run_autonomous_tick
functions.title: Run autonomous tick
functions.description: Advance all in-progress projects one stage through the deterministic assembly line. Runs the five validation gates, writes work packets and immutable audit receipts, and halts at protected stages that need human approval. Call to make progress on builds autonomously.

functions.name: scrape_url
functions.title: Scrape a URL
functions.description: Fetch a public URL and return its title, text content, and up to 100 links. Use for research, lead generation, and benchmarking. Admin only.

url.description: The public http(s) URL to fetch

functions.name: supabase_exec
functions.title: Run Supabase SQL
functions.description: Run a SQL query against the connected Supabase project. Set write=true for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL; omit for read-only SELECT. Admin only.

write.description: True for writes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL); false for read-only SELECT

functions.name: drive_manage
functions.title: Manage Google Drive files
functions.description: List/search files or upload a generated document to the connected Google Drive. action=list with optional q (Drive query string), or action=upload with name, content, and mimeType. Admin only.

mimeType.description: MIME type for upload, default text/plain

functions.name: benchmark_url
functions.title: Benchmark a URL
functions.description: Deterministically score a URL (or batch of URLs) against the five quality gates — static, functional, security, visual, operational. Returns a composite 0-100 per URL and stores tagged Benchmark records. Use to compare external systems vs ours. Admin only.

generator.description: Agent/generator tag for the target (default external)
